paragraphs.text: QuickMove offers a fixed price based on the number of rooms, so customers know the full cost before the move. It provides packing boxes free of charge but does not pack items for customers.
CarefulHands charges by the hour. Its staff will pack everything, including fragile items such as glasses and pictures, and the company is insured for damage up to £50,000.
CityVan is the cheapest option, but customers must help to load and unload the van. It works only within the city and does not operate on Sundays.
QuickMove and CarefulHands both offer storage for customers whose new home is not ready. CarefulHands also offers a cleaning service for the property that customers are leaving.

All three companies ask for a deposit of 20 per cent when the move is booked, and each can usually offer a date within two weeks. Customers are advised to book early in summer, when demand is highest.

items.quote: customers must help to load and unload the van
items.prompt: expects customers to carry some of their own belongings

explanation.en: At CityVan customers do some of the work: “customers must help to load and unload the van”, which is why it is cheapest → C.
explanation.kk: CityVan-да клиенттер өздері көмектеседі: «customers must help to load and unload the van». Сондықтан бұл ең арзан нұсқа → C.
explanation.ru: В CityVan клиенты помогают сами: «customers must help to load and unload the van». Поэтому это самый дешёвый вариант → C.

items.quote: customers know the full cost before the move
items.prompt: tells customers the total price in advance

explanation.en: QuickMove: a fixed price, so “customers know the full cost before the move” → A. CarefulHands charges by the hour.
explanation.kk: QuickMove: тұрақты баға, «customers know the full cost before the move» → A. CarefulHands, керісінше, сағатына алады.
explanation.ru: QuickMove: фиксированная цена, «customers know the full cost before the move» → A. CarefulHands, наоборот, берёт почасово.

items.quote: CarefulHands also offers a cleaning service for the property that customers are leaving
items.prompt: can clean the home that customers are moving out of

explanation.en: Only CarefulHands cleans the old home: it “also offers a cleaning service for the property that customers are leaving” → B.
explanation.kk: Ескі үйді жинауды тек CarefulHands ұсынады: «also offers a cleaning service for the property that customers are leaving» → B.
explanation.ru: Уборку старой квартиры предлагает только CarefulHands: «also offers a cleaning service for the property that customers are leaving» → B.

items.quote: Its staff will pack everything, including fragile items such as glasses and pictures

explanation.en: CarefulHands packs everything, “including fragile items” → B. QuickMove gives boxes but does not pack.
explanation.kk: CarefulHands бәрін, «including fragile items» орайды → B. QuickMove қорап береді, бірақ өзі орамайды.
explanation.ru: CarefulHands упакует всё, «including fragile items» → B. QuickMove даёт коробки, но сама не пакует.

items.quote: It works only within the city and does not operate on Sundays
items.prompt: does not work on one day of the week

explanation.en: CityVan “does not operate on Sundays” → C. C repeats, which the NB allows.
explanation.kk: CityVan «does not operate on Sundays» → C. C әрпі қайталанады — NB рұқсат береді.
explanation.ru: CityVan «does not operate on Sundays» → C. Буква C повторяется — это допускает NB.
